# AI-dō {.unnumbered}

**The Way of AI, grounded in practice (道).**

Anyone can open a chat window and get a fluent answer in seconds. Far fewer can
turn that fluency into work worth standing behind. We all draw on the same
frontier models, so the model was never the edge — **method is**. *AI-dō* is that
method: a structured, human-centred way of working with AI, earned task by task
and checked at every step.

It is a short book, written first-person by a former sceptic and grounded in
primary sources throughout. Read it online from the sidebar, or take it with you:

::: {.dl-buttons}
[Download PDF](ai-do.pdf){.btn-dl .primary}
[Download ePub](ai-do.epub){.btn-dl .ghost}
:::

::: {.callout-note}
This site, the PDF, and the ePub are all built from one set of Markdown
chapters with Quarto — the same source, three outputs, diagrams and citations
included.
:::

Start with the [Preface](preface.qmd), then follow the six-chapter climb from
personal productivity to software, to the disciplines that keep the work sound,
to responsibility, and finally to mastery.
